    1324                                                 function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    1325            1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    1326                                                 endfunction
    1327                                             
    1328                                             `ifndef SYNTHESIS
    1329                                                 initial begin
    1330                                                     if (CSR_DATA_WIDTH != 32) begin
    1331                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: CSR_DATA_WIDTH must be 32");
    1332                                                     end
    1333                                             
    1334                                                     if (STRB_WIDTH != 4) begin
    1335                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: STRB_WIDTH must be 4");
    1336                                                     end
    1337                                             
    1338                                                     if (CSR_ADDR_WIDTH < 12) begin
    1339                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: CSR_ADDR_WIDTH must be at least 12");
    1340                                                     end
    1341                                             
    1342                                                     if (ADDR_WIDTH > 32) begin
    1343                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: ADDR_WIDTH above 32 is not supported by 32-bit CSR registers");
    1344                                                     end
    1345                                             
    1346                                                     if (P16_RECIPE_QUEUE_DEPTH != 4) begin
    1347                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: P16_RECIPE_QUEUE_DEPTH must be 4 for the P16B CSR map");
    1348                                                     end
    1349                                             
    1350                                                     if (GEMM_DIM_WIDTH > 32) begin
    1351                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: GEMM_DIM_WIDTH above 32 is not supported by 32-bit CSR registers");
    1352                                                     end
    1353                                             
    1354                                                     if (!is_power_of_two(STRB_WIDTH)) begin
    1355                                                         $fatal(1, "ai_accel_csr_regs: STRB_WIDTH must be a power of two");
    1356                                                     end
    1357                                                 end
    1358                                             `endif

    1360                                                 // ------------------------------------------------------------
    1361                                                 // Byte-strobe helpers
    1362                                                 // ------------------------------------------------------------
    1363                                                 function automatic logic [31:0] strobe_to_mask(
    1364                                                     input logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] strb
    1365                                                 );
    1366                                                     logic [31:0] mask;
    1367                                                     int unsigned i;
    1368                                                 begin
    1369            1                     204176             mask = 32'h0000_0000;
    1370                                             
    1371            1                     204176             for (i = 0; i < STRB_WIDTH; i++) begin
    1371            2                     816704     
    1372                                                         if (strb[i]) begin
    1373            1                     311156                     mask[(i * 8) +: 8] = 8'hFF;
    1374                                                         end
    1375                                                     end
    1376                                             
    1377            1                     204176             return mask;
    1378                                                 end
    1379                                                 endfunction
    1380                                             
    1381                                                 function automatic logic [31:0] apply_wstrb32(
    1382                                                     input logic [31:0]           old_value,
    1383                                                     input logic [31:0]           new_value,
    1384                                                     input logic [STRB_WIDTH-1:0] strb
    1385                                                 );
    1386                                                     logic [31:0] mask;
    1387                                                 begin
    1388            1                      18458             mask = strobe_to_mask(strb);
    1389            1                      18458             return (old_value & ~mask) | (new_value & mask);
    1390                                                 end
    1391                                                 endfunction

    1394                                                 function automatic bit recipe_slot_addr_is_valid(
    1395                                                     input logic [CSR_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    1396                                                 );
    1397                                                     int unsigned slot_idx;
    1398                                                     logic [CSR_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rel_addr;
    1399                                                     logic [6:0] slot_offset;
    1400                                                 begin
    1401                                                     if (addr < CSR_RECIPE_SLOT_BASE_ADDR) begin
    1402            1                          8                 return 1'b0;
    1403                                                     end
    1404                                             
    1405            1                       3686             rel_addr    = addr - CSR_RECIPE_SLOT_BASE_ADDR;
    1406            1                       3686             slot_idx    = rel_addr >> 7;
    1407            1                       3686             slot_offset = rel_addr[6:0];

    1410            1                          8                 return 1'b0;
    1411                                                     end

    1441                                                 function automatic bit recipe_slot_descriptor_valid(
    1442                                                     input int unsigned slot_idx
    1443                                                 );

    1445                                                     logic [1:0] slot_output_mode;

    1448            1                    ***0***                 return 1'b0;
    1449                                                     end
    1450

    1453

    1455            1                         19                 return 1'b0;
    1456                                                     end

    1459            1                         19                 return 1'b0;

    1463                                                     // sequencer, not the unused upper bits of the 32-bit CSR storage.

    1472            1                         40                 return 1'b0;

    444                                                  function automatic logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] calc_ktile_len(
    445                                                      input logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] base_k
    446                                                  );
    447                                                      int unsigned remaining;
    448                                                      int unsigned tile_limit;
    449                                                  begin
    450             1                        230             tile_limit = GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    451                                              
    452                                                      if (int'(dim_k) > int'(base_k)) begin
    453             1                        230                 remaining = int'(dim_k) - int'(base_k);
    454                                                      end
    455                                                      else begin
    456             1                    ***0***                 remaining = 0;
    457                                                      end
    458                                              
    459                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin
    460             1                         94                 calc_ktile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(tile_limit);
    461                                                      end
    462                                                      else begin
    463             1                        136                 calc_ktile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(remaining);
    464                                                      end
    465                                                  end
    466                                                  endfunction

    473                                                  begin
    474             1                        152             tile_limit = GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    475

    478                                                      end

    482                                              
    483                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin

    492                                                  function automatic logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] calc_mtile_len(
    493                                                      input logic [DIM_WIDTH-1:0] base_m
    494                                                  );
    495                                                      int unsigned remaining;
    496                                                      int unsigned tile_limit;
    497                                                  begin
    498             1                         54             tile_limit = GEMM_M_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE;
    499                                              
    500                                                      if (int'(dim_m) > int'(base_m)) begin
    501             1                         54                 remaining = int'(dim_m) - int'(base_m);
    502                                                      end
    503                                                      else begin
    504             1                    ***0***                 remaining = 0;
    505                                                      end
    506                                              
    507                                                      if (remaining > tile_limit) begin
    508             1                         39                 calc_mtile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(tile_limit);
    509                                                      end
    510                                                      else begin
    511             1                         15                 calc_mtile_len = DIM_WIDTH'(remaining);
    512                                                      end
    513                                                  end
    514                                                  endfunction
    515                                              
    516             1                        641         always_comb begin
    517             1                        641             b_cache_dim_supported =
    518                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    519                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    520                                                          (int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    521                                                          (int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N);
    522                                              
    523             1                        641             b_cache_active_calc =
    524                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_B_CACHE && b_cache_dim_supported;
    525                                              
    526                                                      // First P5 policy:
    527                                                      // - packed B-cache preload is optional and default-off
    528                                                      // - packed preload only supports int8 B elements
    529                                                      // - packed preload only activates when base_addr_b is 4-byte aligned
    530                                                      // - unaligned B bases automatically fall back to the scalar P4 preload path
    531             1                        641             packed_bcache_preload_calc =
    532                                                          b_cache_active_calc &&
    533                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_PACKED_BCACHE_PRELOAD &&
    534                                                          (B_BYTES == 1) &&
    535                                                          (base_addr_b[1:0] == 2'b00);
    536                                              
    537                                                      // First P6 policy:
    538                                                      // - A-row cache is optional and default-off
    539                                                      // - A-row cache requires B-cache for the first implementation
    540                                                      // - A-row cache only supports scalar int8 A preload in P6C
    541                                                      // - unsupported dimensions automatically fall back to the P5 path
    542             1                        641             a_row_cache_dim_supported =
    543                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    544                                                          (int'(dim_k) <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K);
    545                                              
    546             1                        641             a_row_cache_active_calc =
    547                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_A_ROW_CACHE &&
    548                                                          b_cache_active_calc &&
    549                                                          a_row_cache_dim_supported &&
    550                                                          (A_BYTES == 1);
    551                                              
    552                                                      // First P7 policy:
    553                                                      // - packed A-row preload is optional and default-off
    554                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires A-row cache to be active
    555                                                      // - packed A-row preload only supports int8 A elements
    556                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires base_addr_a to be 4-byte aligned
    557                                                      // - packed A-row preload requires dim_k to be a multiple of 4
    558                                                      // - unsupported cases automatically fall back to the P6 scalar A-row preload path
    559             1                        641             packed_a_row_preload_calc =
    560                                                          a_row_cache_active_calc &&
    561                                                          GEMM_ENABLE_PACKED_A_ROW_PRELOAD &&
    562                                                          (A_BYTES == 1) &&
    563                                                          (base_addr_a[1:0] == 2'b00) &&
    564                                                          (dim_k[1:0] == 2'b00);
    565                                              
    566                                                      // P10D K-tiling policy:
    567                                                      // - K-tiling is default-off and only activates when K exceeds the
    568                                                      //   effective cache tile capacity.
    569                                                      // - The first tiled path is cache-backed and row-accumulator based.
    570                                                      // - Packed preloads may still be enabled for non-tiled P9/P10C cases,
    571                                                      //   but the tiled path uses scalar tile preload for robust
    572                                                      //   tail/alignment behavior.
    573             1                        641             k_tiling_dim_supported =
    574                                                          (dim_k != '0) &&
    575                                                          (dim_n != '0) &&
    576                                                          (int'(dim_k) > GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) &&
    577                                                          (int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_N) &&
    578                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&
    579                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_A_ROW_CACHE_MAX_K);
    580

    590                                                      // P11D N-tiling policy:
    591                                                      // - N-tiling is default-off and only activates when N exceeds the

    616                                                      // - M-tiling is default-off and only activates when M exceeds the
    617                                                      //   effective output-row tile size.
    618                                                      // - The first multi-row path is cache-backed and reuses one B tile

    620                                                      // - If K/N exceed their effective tile sizes, the P10/P11 K/N tile

    630                                                          (GEMM_K_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE <= GEMM_B_CACHE_MAX_K) &&

    632                                                          ((int'(dim_n) <= GEMM_N_TILE_SIZE_EFFECTIVE) || GEMM_ENABLE_N_TILING) &&

    1                                                // File: rtl/mem/axi_mm_dual_port_bram.sv
    2                                                
    3                                                // ============================================================
    4                                                // Behavioral Multi-clock Dual-port AXI4-MM BRAM
    5                                                //
    6                                                // Introduction
    7                                                // - This is a verification-oriented behavioral memory model
    8                                                // - Two independent AXI4-MM slave ports share one behavioral storage array
    9                                                // - Deterministic, burst-level commit semantics suitable for scoreboards
    10                                               //
    11                                               // Important behavior
    12                                               // - W beats are buffered per burst (writes are NOT applied beat-by-beat into mem_word[])
    13                                               // - A single commit engine (dma_clk domain) commits ONE burst at a time
    14                                               // --  Memory update is atomic per burst (the mem_word[] image changes at burst commit boundary)
    15                                               // --  Commits from Port0/Port1 are serialized by the commit engine
    16                                               // - Apply / commit observation
    17                                               // --  After mem_word[] is updated, apply_if emits the applied beats
    18                                               // --  commit_if emits the committed beats
    19                                               // - Write response timing
    20                                               // --  Port0: B is enqueued only after commit_if emission completes
    21                                               // --  Port1: Last beat ACK back to core_clk is deferred until commit+emit completes; core-side B is then generated
    22                                               // --  B responses remain stable under BREADY backpressure and dequeue only on external BVALID && BREADY
    23                                               // --  Per-port B FIFO enqueue/dequeue accounting is atomic, including same-cycle push+pop
    24                                               //
    25                                               // Clocking / domains
    26                                               // - Port0 runs on dma_clk (AXI slave interface axi0_if)
    27                                               // - Port1 runs on core_clk (AXI slave interface axi1_if)
    28                                               // - Port1 W beats cross into dma_clk via a simple toggle-based request/ack bridge
    29                                               // - The shared storage is a single behavioral array updated only by the dma_clk commit engine
    30                                               //
    31                                               // Verification constraint
    32                                               // - This model is multi-clock (Port0: dma_clk, Port1: core_clk)
    33                                               // - Recommended scoreboard setting: COMMIT_STABLE_DELAY = 30ns
    34                                               // --  This is a testbench constraint to avoid race condition, not a hardware guarantee and not a DUT parameter
    35                                               //
    36                                               // Read path model
    37                                               // - Synchronous read model with 2-cycle latency and per-port read FIFO
    38                                               // - No read forwarding/bypass 
    39                                               // -- Reads observe committed mem_word[] state only
    40                                               //
    41                                               // Assumptions & scope
    42                                               // - Burst types
    43                                               // -- INCR and WRAP are supported
    44                                               // -- FIXED is supported as constant-address accesses
    45                                               // - Responses
    46                                               // -- BRESP/RRESP are OKAY (2'b00) only
    47                                               // - Write ordering
    48                                               // -- W channel is assumed in-order with respect to the active AW (no W reordering across different AW)
    49                                               // - No vendor-specific collision modes are modeled
    50                                               // -- This is not intended to infer a true dual-port BRAM macro
    51                                               //
    52                                               // Endianness / lane mapping
    53                                               // - lane 0 = WDATA[7:0], lowest byte address in word
    54                                               // - WSTRB[0] controls lane 0...N
    55                                               // ============================================================
    56

    5                                                // Scope:

    3                                                // ai_accel_queue_fetch_controller
    4                                                // ============================================================
    5                                                // P24C single-outstanding command queue fetch controller.
    6                                                //
    7                                                // Scope through P24C:
    8                                                //   - Reads one 64-byte SQ command entry from command memory.
    9                                                //   - Parses and validates the command entry.
    10                                               //   - Presents one accepted/rejected command context to downstream logic.
    11                                               //   - Does not launch P17 descriptor fetch directly yet.
    12                                               //   - Does not update SQ_HEAD / CQ_TAIL directly.
    13                                               //   - Adds queue disabled / invalid config / empty / full / bad pointer handling.
    14                                               //   - Exposes CMD_TIMEOUT_CYCLES from SQ word6 to the wrapper-level
    15                                               //     P24C watchdog. Runtime timeout detection remains in the CSR top
    16                                               //     queue glue because this fetch block does not own the downstream
    17                                               //     descriptor/recipe/completion terminal state.
    18                                               //
    19                                               // Integration intent for P19D/P19E:
    20                                               //   cmd_valid/cmd_ready handshake becomes the boundary into the existing
    21                                               //   descriptor-fetch launch path and completion-writeback allocation path.
    22                                               //
    23                                               // Baseline assumptions:
    24                                               //   - DATA_WIDTH = 64 for the current subsystem baseline.
    25                                               //   - SQ entry size = 64 bytes, 16 logical 32-bit words.
    26                                               //   - CQ entry size = 64 bytes, existing P18 completion record format.
    27                                               //   - One outstanding command context at a time.
    28                                               // ============================================================

    393             1                         67                 detail_code = P27_DETAIL_SPAN_CONFIG;
    394             1                         67                 return 1'b0;

    402             1                          2                 return 1'b0;

    405             1                         21                 return 1'b0;

    262                                                  function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    263             1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    264                                                  endfunction
    265                                              
    266                                                  function automatic bit addr_is_aligned(
    267                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    268                                                  );
    269                                                      if (BYTES_PER_BEAT <= 1) begin
    270                                                          return 1'b1;
    271                                                      end
    272                                                      else begin
    273             1                        826                 return (addr[BEAT_ADDR_LSB-1:0] == '0);
    274                                                      end
    275                                                  endfunction

    280                                                      input logic [31:0]           beats
    281                                                  );
    282             1                        416             return (beats != 0) &&
    283                                                             addr_is_aligned(src_addr) &&
    284                                                             addr_is_aligned(dst_addr);

    284                                                  function automatic bit is_power_of_two(input int value);
    285             1                    ***0***             return (value > 0) && ((value & (value - 1)) == 0);
    286                                                  endfunction
    287                                              
    288                                                  function automatic bit addr_is_aligned(
    289                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr
    290                                                  );
    291                                                      if (BYTES_PER_BEAT <= 1) begin
    292                                                          return 1'b1;
    293                                                      end
    294                                                      else begin
    295             1                       1034                 return (addr[BEAT_ADDR_LSB-1:0] == '0);
    296                                                      end
    297                                                  endfunction
    298                                              
    299                                                  function automatic bit is_valid_operand_sel(input logic sel);
    300             1                        514             return (sel === OPERAND_A) || (sel === OPERAND_B);
    301                                                  endfunction

    303                                                  function automatic bit launch_is_valid(
    304                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] src_addr,
    305                                                      input logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] dst_addr,
    306                                                      input logic [31:0]           beats,
    307                                                      input logic                  operand_sel
    308                                                  );

    310                                                             addr_is_aligned(src_addr) &&
    311                                                             addr_is_aligned(dst_addr) &&
    312                                                             is_valid_operand_sel(operand_sel);

    11                                                   // Owner select
    12                                                   //
    13                                                   // Legacy naming:
    14                                                   //   select_dma = DMA_LOAD owner select
    15                                                   //
    16                                                   // Owner policy:
    17                                                   //   select_dma       = 0, select_dma_store = 0 -> HOST owns Port0
    18                                                   //   select_dma       = 1, select_dma_store = 0 -> DMA_LOAD owns Port0
    19                                                   //   select_dma       = 0, select_dma_store = 1 -> DMA_STORE owns Port0
    20                                                   //   select_dma       = 1, select_dma_store = 1 -> illegal, Port0 held inactive
    21                                                   //
    22                                                   // Rules:
    23                                                   //   - No arbitration / outstanding tracking is done here.
    24                                                   //   - Owner select must only change when Port0 is idle.
    25                                                   //   - Host traffic must not be issued while DMA load/store owns Port0.
    26                                                   //
    27                                                   // P13 note:
    28                                                   //   DMA_STORE may be used after a C RMW accumulation sequence, but this
    29                                                   //   mux only sees the final store transaction. It does not participate
    30                                                   //   in GEMM partial accumulation.

    588                                                  // Phase-based ownership:
    589                                                  //   no DMA load/store active -> Host owns Port0
    590                                                  //   dma_load_busy_i          -> DMA load owns Port0
    591                                                  //   dma_store_busy_i         -> DMA store owns Port0

    593                                                  // Host traffic must not be issued while either DMA engine owns Port0.

    604             1                    ***0***                 $error("ai_accel_subsys: dma_load_busy_i and dma_store_busy_i are both asserted");
    605                                                      end
    606                                                  end
    607                                              `endif
    608                                              
    609                                                  // ============================================================
    610                                                  // Accelerator control CDC
    611                                                  //
    612                                                  // External acc_start/config are considered dma_clk-domain.
    613                                                  //
    614                                                  // Flow:
    615                                                  //   dma_clk:
    616                                                  //     - detect acc_start rising edge
    617                                                  //     - capture config bus
    618                                                  //     - toggle start event
    619                                                  //
    620                                                  //   core_clk:
    621                                                  //     - synchronize start toggle
    622                                                  //     - generate one-cycle raw start event
    623                                                  //     - latch captured config into core-domain registers
    624                                                  //     - launch GEMM one core_clk cycle later
    625                                                  //
    626                                                  // Notes:
    627                                                  //   This is a bundled-data style CDC for configuration.
    628                                                  //   The config registers are captured in dma_clk before the
    629                                                  //   start event reaches core_clk. The source config registers
    630                                                  //   must remain stable until the start event is sampled in
    631                                                  //   core_clk. Current software/testbench sequencing satisfies
    632                                                  //   this because config is only changed between GEMM jobs.
    633                                                  //
    634                                                  // Frontend preload rule:
    635                                                  //   GEMM start is accepted only when the accelerator, AXI-Stream
    636                                                  //   preload, and Direct Stream preload are all idle. This prevents
    637                                                  //   GEMM from consuming operands before the selected preload path is
    638                                                  //   complete and prevents a second launch while the first launch is
    639                                                  //   still crossing into core_clk.
    640                                                  //
    641                                                  // Launch reservation:
    642                                                  //   Once a GEMM start is accepted in dma_clk, acc_busy is asserted
    643                                                  //   immediately through acc_launch_pending_dma_q. The reservation is
    644                                                  //   held until synchronized core-domain busy takes ownership, closing
    645                                                  //   the accepted-start -> synchronized-busy adjacent-command window.
    646                                                  // ============================================================
    647                                              
    648                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    649                                                  // dma_clk side: acc_start rising-edge detect
    650                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    651                                                  logic acc_start_dma_q;
    652                                                  logic acc_start_pulse_dma;
    653                                                  logic acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted;
    654                                                  logic acc_launch_pending_dma_q;
    655                                              
    656             1                       3206         assign acc_start_pulse_dma = acc_start & ~acc_start_dma_q;
    657                                              
    658                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    659                                                  // dma_clk side: Direct Stream committed-extent launch validation
    660                                                  //
    661                                                  // Required payload size is derived from the current launch dimensions.
    662                                                  // Committed payload size is derived from the most recent successful
    663                                                  // Direct Stream preload completion.  64-bit arithmetic avoids truncating
    664                                                  // the dimension products before the safety comparisons.
    665                                                  //
    666                                                  // A/B completed beat counts include final stream-beat padding, so legal
    667                                                  // tails such as the 1022-byte A case are accepted when 1024 bytes were
    668                                                  // successfully committed.  Physical capacity is checked independently so
    669                                                  // a padded/committed extent cannot legalize a dimension footprint beyond
    670                                                  // the actual operand buffer.
    671                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    672             1                       1805         always_comb begin
    673             1                       1805             ds_required_a_bytes_dma =
    674                                                          64'(dim_m) * 64'(dim_k) * 64'(GEMM_A_WIDTH / 8);
    675                                              
    676             1                       1805             ds_required_b_bytes_dma =
    677                                                          64'(dim_k) * 64'(dim_n) * 64'(GEMM_B_WIDTH / 8);
    678                                              
    679             1                       1805             ds_a_committed_bytes_dma =
    680                                                          64'(ds_a_completed_beats) * 64'(DATA_WIDTH / 8);
    681                                              
    682             1                       1805             ds_b_committed_bytes_dma =
    683                                                          64'(ds_b_completed_beats) * 64'(DATA_WIDTH / 8);
    684                                              
    685             1                       1805             ds_gemm_extent_ok_i =
    686                                                          ds_a_extent_valid &&
    687                                                          ds_b_extent_valid &&
    688                                                          (ds_required_a_bytes_dma <= ds_a_committed_bytes_dma) &&
    689                                                          (ds_required_b_bytes_dma <= ds_b_committed_bytes_dma) &&
    690                                                          (ds_required_a_bytes_dma <= 64'(DS_A_BUFFER_BYTES)) &&
    691                                                          (ds_required_b_bytes_dma <= 64'(DS_B_BUFFER_BYTES));
    692                                                  end
    693                                              
    694                                                  assign ds_gemm_extent_ok = ds_gemm_extent_ok_i;
    695                                              
    696             1                       1667         assign acc_start_stream_guard_ok =
    697                                                      !gemm_input_stream_mode ||
    698                                                      (ds_operands_ready_sync2_dma_q && ds_gemm_extent_ok_i);
    699                                              
    700             1                       3686         assign acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted =
    701                                                      acc_start_pulse_dma      &&
    702                                                      !acc_busy                &&
    703                                                      !axis_load_busy_i        &&
    704                                                      !ds_load_busy_i          &&
    705                                                      acc_start_stream_guard_ok;
    706                                              
    707             1                       1678         assign acc_start_reject =
    708                                                      acc_start_pulse_dma && !acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted;
    709                                              
    710             1                       2532         always_ff @(posedge dma_clk or negedge dma_rst_n) begin
    711                                                      if (!dma_rst_n) begin
    712             1                        310                 acc_start_dma_q <= 1'b0;
    713                                                      end
    714                                                      else begin
    715             1                       2222                 acc_start_dma_q <= acc_start;
    716                                                      end
    717                                                  end
    718                                              
    719                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    720                                                  // dma_clk side: captured GEMM configuration
    721                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    722                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_a_dma_q;
    723                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_b_dma_q;
    724                                                  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]     base_addr_c_dma_q;

    736                                                      if (!dma_rst_n) begin
    737             1                        310                 base_addr_a_dma_q <= '0;

    749                                                      end
    750                                                      else if (acc_start_pulse_dma_accepted) begin
    751             1                        688                 base_addr_a_dma_q <= base_addr_a;
    752             1                        688                 base_addr_b_dma_q <= base_addr_b;

    766                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    767                                                  // core_clk side: start toggle synchronizer
    768                                                  //
    769                                                  // The armed flag prevents a false start pulse after reset when
    770                                                  // the synchronized toggle value initializes to the current
    771                                                  // source-domain toggle value.
    772                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    773                                                  logic start_sync1_q;
    774                                                  logic start_sync2_q;

    783             1                        460                 start_sync1_q      <= 1'b0;
    784             1                        460                 start_sync2_q      <= 1'b0;
    785             1                        460                 start_sync2_qq     <= 1'b0;
    786             1                        460                 start_sync_armed_q <= 1'b0;
    787                                                      end
    788                                                      else if (!start_sync_armed_q) begin
    789             1                        155                 start_sync1_q      <= start_toggle_dma_q;

    791             1                        155                 start_sync2_qq     <= start_toggle_dma_q;

    795             1                       2907                 start_sync1_q      <= start_toggle_dma_q;

    798                                                      end
    799                                                  end

    861                                                  // ============================================================
    862                                                  // Direct-stream operand region size calculation
    863                                                  //
    864                                                  // Direct Stream mode redirects only A/B reads to the operand buffer.
    865                                                  // The router uses padded A/B byte regions so final stream-beat padding
    866                                                  // remains valid. Reads outside those regions, including C RMW old-C
    867                                                  // reads, stay on the scratchpad path.
    868                                                  // ============================================================
    869                                                  logic [31:0] direct_a_bytes_core;
    870                                                  logic [31:0] direct_b_bytes_core;
    871                                                  logic [31:0] direct_a_region_bytes_core;
    872                                                  logic [31:0] direct_b_region_bytes_core;
    873                                              
    874                                                  function automatic logic [31:0] round_up_to_data_beat(
    875                                                      input logic [31:0] byte_count
    876                                                  );
    877                                                      logic [31:0] beat_bytes;
    878                                                      logic [31:0] rem;
    879                                                  begin
    880             1                       1282             beat_bytes = 32'(DATA_WIDTH / 8);
    881             1                       1282             rem        = byte_count % beat_bytes;
    882                                              
    883                                                      if (byte_count == 0) begin
    884             1                        608                 round_up_to_data_beat = 32'd0;
    885                                                      end
    886                                                      else if (rem == 0) begin
    887             1                        318                 round_up_to_data_beat = byte_count;
    888                                                      end
    889                                                      else begin
    890             1                        356                 round_up_to_data_beat = byte_count + beat_bytes - rem;
    891                                                      end
    892                                                  end
    893                                                  endfunction
    894                                              
    895             1                        641         always_comb begin
    896             1                        641             direct_a_bytes_core =
    897                                                          32'(int'(dim_m_core_q) * int'(dim_k_core_q) * (GEMM_A_WIDTH / 8));
    898                                              
    899             1                        641             direct_b_bytes_core =
    900                                                          32'(int'(dim_k_core_q) * int'(dim_n_core_q) * (GEMM_B_WIDTH / 8));
    901                                              
    902             1                        641             direct_a_region_bytes_core = round_up_to_data_beat(direct_a_bytes_core);
    903             1                        641             direct_b_region_bytes_core = round_up_to_data_beat(direct_b_bytes_core);
    904                                                  end
